name: drive-to-delivery
job: Drive one accepted multi-phase objective (engineering or product) to its asked terminal.

inScope: Running research, execute, path-run, and repair/replan loops until the asked terminal
Landing source via one revert-safe complete PR outcome per objective
Recording honest blockers when the terminal cannot be met
Product-objective mode when the asked terminal is a product result
outOfScope: Open-ended product betterment without an accepted objective

inputs: One accepted multi-phase objective and acceptance map
Workspace ownership and host continuity bindings
outputs: One revert-safe complete PR outcome per independent outcome
Honest blocker record if terminal is unreachable

tools: CI and delivery tooling for the active boundary
permissions: delivery authority owned by the active profile

failureSemantics: The loop continues until the asked terminal is met or an honest blocker is recorded. Reversible local work is done when the changed path is correct. Landed or live may be claimed only when that layer is actually true.

outcome.observable: The accepted objective reaches its asked terminal, or a recorded honest blocker, after running the path you changed.
